results.title: Chopped
results.overview: Tama and his dad runs a famous fish shop at a market. He will soon take over the business when his dad retires, yet Tama has this lingering thought that his strict dad won't approve him. Although, reality sometimes differs.

results.title: Late
results.overview: After his sister Eva is kidnapped, a young man sets out with his father to find her. As they drive through the night, tensions rise, old conflicts resurface, and the situation begins to spiral out of control.

results.title: Ghosts In Google Street View
results.overview: Ghosts In Google Street View is an experimental short film that brings together desktop aesthetics, simulated reenactments, and images from everyday life. The film centers on an ordinary stray dog photograph that artist Kadir Kayserilioğlu encounters by chance on Google Street View. Deeply affected by the image, the artist travels to the coordinates where the photograph was taken in an attempt to find the dog in real life. What begins as a journey tracing the image of an animal gradually transforms into a reflective narrative in which digital representations and physical encounters intertwine, extending toward themes of creation and annihilation.

results.title: What If Christmas
results.overview: Erin has always supported her husband Adam, a heart surgeon, by organizing the hospitals' Christmas charity galas. However, when he moves to a new hospital, her help is no longer needed. Feeling lost and without a purpose back in New York City, her long-suppressed regrets over giving up her dream of pursuing fashion design start bubbling up. When Erin is given a peculiar heart-shaped Christmas ornament, she wakes up in an alternate reality where she's a world-famous fashion designer. As she "meets" and attends Christmas events with alternate-universe Adam, she realizes that while her fashion dreams came true, it's lonely at the top. While working on a way to bring more charity and heart to her fashion empire, she learns that her dream life and love were always right in front of her – if only she finds the heart and courage to ask.

results.title: Hell Has No Fire Escape
results.overview: Inheriting her husband’s evangelical drug clinic, Ina Dry clings to faith - until an online romance with “Jason Momoa” awakens desires that threaten her ministry and those who rely on her.

results.title: Parléaz, Mon Village
results.overview: Maurice, who emigrated in the early 20th century to France from Parléaz, a small village in the Aosta Valley, returns as a spirit to his mountains, recounting his life and his connection to the land. Meanwhile, the stories and experiences of the local community, from the older to the younger generations, become intertwined.

results.title: Officer Grey
results.overview: Found Footage Horror Film  Produced by Impound Comics  Synopsis:  Officer Sarah Grey is known for killing five fellow police officers before taking her own life. This heinous act leaves the community with more questions than answers. Now, her body camera footage is finally being released, providing the public with much needed answers!  Directed & Written By: Brent Trayce Sands  DP: Andrew Johnston  Starring: Unissa Cruse, Derek Casper & Orianna Fancher

results.title: EGG
results.overview: A musician loses something important and awakes on a quest to retrieve what is lost.

results.title: The Infinite
results.overview: Charlie Donovan, on the brink of losing everything he loves, is drawn into a fateful journey with seven strange strangers, each of whom holds a key to save him from self-destruction.

results.title: Toy Bunny
results.overview: Following the events of Pet Bunny: Ivory (or Willow/"Will") has moved back in with her parents and their dogs. After the dogs rip apart a toy bunny - and a bottle of mysterious fluid spills, onto a wooden hare - this family finds themselves faced with an inhuman threat.

results.title: Investigation: City of Pipes
results.overview: In 2014, Kaohsiung was struck by an unprecedented petrochemical gas explosion, exposing once again the city's unresolved dependence on heavy industry. Through a fictional investigation, this film adopts "voice" as its investigative method. Beginning with the ruptured petrochemical pipeline that caused the disaster, it gradually reveals the relationship between Kaohsiung's petrochemical industry and its citizens, while uncovering an industrial history that spans Taiwan's transition from authoritarian rule to democracy.

results.title: Good Girls
results.overview: In a correctional centre for girls, teens are kept safe from society and themselves, getting reprogrammed to become good female citizens in today’s Poland. But what does it take to become a “good girl”? And is that even something they want?

results.title: Farewell, Rivers
results.overview: The last inhabitants of a mountain village resist a time that transforms the ways of life in the region. Eladio, the ranger, witnesses the fate of a community where humans disappear and animals remain. While a bear wanders through the valley, invisible threads are weaven that plot stories of care, loss and resistance.

results.title: Good Help
results.overview: Between 2023 and 2024, nearly 40,000 Venezuelan migrants were bused from Texas to Denver, Colorado. After traveling more than 3,000 treacherous miles on foot - many with young children in tow - they found themselves living on Denver’s streets in the middle of winter, without housing or legal permission to work.

results.title: Proposal
results.overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

results.title: In The Ever
results.overview: Blending intimate voice-over with the fractured memories of a 1970s folksinger, IN THE EVER follows Sam Ellis, a mechanic, whose songs written for his dead mother become a surprise hit. Unable to cope with fame, Sam retreats to a desert ranch, where an unexpected love affair forces him to confront his pain in order to move forward.  The film is a love letter infused in music. With 70s needle drops, an original score by Sonny Luca, and original music by lead actor and co-writer/director C.M. Sutton, watching IN THE EVER feels like listening to a complete album.

results.title: BTS: THE RETURN
results.overview: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.

results.title: Friends Like Us
results.overview: A dark comedic thriller where two sitcom actors have to reenact a new version of their show’s series finale after a crazed fan keeps them hostage.

results.title: Sapiro vs. Ford: The Jew Who Sued Henry Ford
results.original_title: Sapiro vs. Ford: The Jew Who Sued Henry Ford
results.overview: In the 1920s, a Jewish lawyer challenges automobile magnate Henry Ford with a landmark libel suit that confronts virulent antisemitic attacks.
